description: This script performs link auditing within documentation files, resolving routes, handling redirects, and checking for broken links in markdown files and navigation configuration. It includes functions for normalizing routes, walking directory trees, sanitizing config data, and executing external link checking commands.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively traverses a directory to list all files.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path string.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects navigation page entries from a nested navigation structure.

methods.name: isLocalizedDocPath
methods.description: Checks if a path matches localized documentation path pattern.

methods.name: isGeneratedTranslatedDoc
methods.description: Determines if a relative path corresponds to a generated translation document.

methods.name: sanitizeDocsConfigForEnglishOnly
methods.description: Sanitizes documentation configuration objects to include only English content.

methods.name: prepareAnchorAuditDocsDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for auditing, copying docs, and sanitizing config.

methods.name: auditDocsLinks
methods.description: Checks markdown files and navigation config for broken links and unresolved routes.

methods.name: runDocsLinkAuditCli
methods.description: CLI entry point to run link audits, optionally checking anchors.
